reflection_theorem.statement: For L=k^m,U=(k+1)^m, U-L is odd for every integer m>=1.
reflection_theorem.proof: x^m≡x (mod 2), hence U-L≡1 (mod 2). The midpoint is a half-integer; reflection has no integer fixed point; monotone complementarity uniquely splits lower/upper.
